summary: IES Holdings filed an 8-K on July 31, 2026, reporting Q3 FY2026 earnings and announcing a two-for-one forward stock split of its common stock. The split increases share count for holders of record on August 14, 2026, with additional shares distributed after close of trading on August 21, 2026. No price per share, premium, or deal value stated. This is a mechanical capital-return action, not a buyback or dividend. Watch for potential post-split price adjustment and liquidity changes; no arbitrage angle applies.
